Sana (People Ops): quick heads-up — final onsite for candidate Aisha is next Thu 03/12 09:00-11:00 PT. We need: 1) scribe for notes/transcript, 2) debrief lead, 3) confirm rubric split (system-design vs coding vs product). Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.example/abcd
Leo (ML Infra): I can scribe the first hour if no one else can. happy to take notes and upload to drive. :writing_hand:
Ryan (DevEx): I can handle the debrief lead — will collect notes and run the calibration doc. Do we want to weight system design higher here? Candidate has infra-heavy background.
Maya (Hiring): Hiring rubric currently set to 40% coding / 40% system-design / 20% communication. For this role we can shift to 30/50/20 if the panel agrees. Need a +1 or -1 from Eng reps.
Priya (Eng): 50% system-design sounds right to me. One ask: can we add a short prompt set for the coding round to standardize scoring? I have two quick problems — short/medium.
Sana (People Ops): Good call. @Priya please paste your prompts here. Also need consent for recording/transcript — candidate said yes in intake but we should reconfirm before the session.
Priya (Eng): prompts: ```
1) short: implement a rate limiter LRU-style (api: allowRequest(userId))
2) medium: design an autoscaling KV cache for read-heavy workloads, explain hot-shard mitigation
```
Leo (ML Infra): Those look good. For scribe coverage: I can do 9:00-10:00, Maya can take 10:00-11:00? @Maya confirm
Maya (Hiring): yep can do second half. I'll ensure timestamped notes and tag owners for followups. Also will post the debrief doc link before the call.
People Ops Bot: Reminder scheduled: send "panel materials" email 24h before session to panelists. (Scheduled by Sana)
Ryan (DevEx): Quick ops ask — can someone run a last-minute PR check for the infra test harness? Link: https://git.redwood/example/pr/482. If harness fails, we'll fallback to the alternate coding prompt.
Priya (Eng): I'll glance at the PR this afternoon. If I can't finish, ping me in #eng and I'll prioritize.
Sana (People Ops): Action items:
- Priya: post standardized prompts + confirm time to review PR (by EOD)
- Leo/Maya: scribe coverage confirmed
- Ryan: debrief lead
- Everyone: reply if you object to 30/50/20 split; otherwise I'll update rubric and post final doc
Priya (Eng): Acked. No objections from me on 30/50/20.
Leo (ML Infra): Ack. I'll upload the notes to the candidate folder and tag reviewers.
Maya (Hiring): ACK — will post debrief doc + scoring sheet tomorrow morning.
Sana (People Ops): thanks all. If anything changes (candidate time shift or no-show), post here and I'll coordinate backups. :seedling:
Ryan (DevEx): one last ask — can someone grab a quick code-review shadow during the call? 10-10:20 would be ideal. @Priya? :eyes:
Priya (Eng): yep can cover 10:00-10:20 for code review shadow. I'll be on standby.
Sana (People Ops): perfect — closing the loop. I'll post final agenda + link to scoring sheet by EOD tomorrow.
